what_to_detect: The resolution of a conspire trigger copies the spell whose conspire cost was paid.
near_miss: A spell with conspire cast without its conspire cost paid: no conspire copy is made.
record_fields: acting line keyword name (the acting line of a keyword-derived ability is the keyword's own line, whose script API type is Keyword, so api cannot single the keyword out)

what_to_detect: Each paid instance of conspire triggers on its own payment and its resolution makes one copy of the spell.
near_miss: An unpaid conspire instance, which makes no copy.
record_fields: acting line keyword name (the acting line of a keyword-derived ability is the keyword's own line, whose script API type is Keyword, so api cannot single the keyword out)
